name: sharper-skills
description: Eight skills: three prompt lenses (higher, deeper, wider), an evidence loop for building and debugging (signal-first-plan, debugging-by-constraints, debug-retro), a creative-selection loop that does open-ended work and picks blind against the plain answer (leonardo), and a report with questions, graded by the agent, that checks you understand what a session decided or changed (defend).

plugins.name: sharper-skills
plugins.description: Prompt lenses that rewrite a task for altitude, depth or range, plus signal-first planning, evidence-first debugging, a creative-selection loop for open-ended work, and an agent-graded quiz on what a session decided or changed.
